name: Jack Stauber
description:
'''Jack Stauber''' (born April 6, 1996) is an American musician, animator, filmmaker, and [[internet personality]] based in [[Pittsburgh]]. He is recognized for his [[VHS]]-aesthetic [[live action]], [[stop motion]], and [[computer animated]] music videos which have been featured in [[internet meme]]s.

He has released the albums ''Finite Form'' (2013), ''Viator'' (2015), ''Reviator'' (2017) ''Pop Food'' (2017), ''HiLo'' (2018), and ''Opal'' (2020). The first two tracks of ''Pop Food'', "Buttercup" and "Oh Klahoma", went viral on [[TikTok]]. In 2020, he won the [[Shorty Awards|Shorty Award]] in the Best in Weird category.
